verdict.rationale: Vast.ai documents SSH-based file transfer and a CLI/API workflow that includes 'copy data' steps, plus persistent Volumes for storage that survives instance destruction, giving developers some documented transfer tooling. However there is no evidence of S3-compatible endpoints or built-in cloud-storage sync (e.g., rclone/S3 integration) for bulk data movement. Missing for 10: S3-compatible storage API, native cloud-sync integration, and any hands-on benchmark of transfer throughput/reliability.
